verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm offering attorney-led petition, visa, and compliance services. Versioned developer APIs with a deprecation policy are a category error for this kind of professional legal service, and nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any API. The only probe found no OpenAPI spec, and the client portal is a document and communication tool, not a programmatic API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
